name: @playliquid/arena-integration
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Arena integration contracts (PL-007). The typed, provider-neutral integration layer between the Game Engineering Lab and the external Arena (architecture.md §Arena, lock rules 6/32): frozen request-kind vocabulary and content-addressed wire request envelopes, authorization scopes for artifact return, typed response envelopes for the three declared return classes (results, evidence, authorized artifacts) with a pure response validator, ingestion-only verdicts producing evidence packages for the Lab's normal evidence path (Arena can never directly mutate PlayLiquid live state), an escalation lifecycle state machine with idempotent send/ingest (E6), audit-tracked authorization decisions, and a pure ArenaTransport port with deterministic in-memory fakes. Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no network, no Arena SDK, no provider client. PENDING (Architecture Change Request, see index.ts): the Lab-side escalation request record built FROM lab-contracts' ArenaEscalationRef — blocked because PL-006 is not merged at base c9cf856; it will import-and-extend ArenaEscalationRef when @playliquid/lab-contracts lands and this package's dependency line is added by the TL.
